children: announced on Tuesday that it agreed to sell 10M shares of Topaz Energy
at C$28.75 per share in a bought deal, generating about C$287.5M in gross proceeds.
The underwriters have an option to purchase up to 15% additional shares to cover over-allotments, exercisable for 30 days after closing, reported in the
The deal is expected to close around October 8, 2026, subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals.

Following the sale, Tourmaline Oil's stake in Topaz Energy will fall from 12.9% to about 6.4%, or 5.4% if the option is fully exercised. However, the Topaz Energy will not receive any proceeds from the offering.

On the other hand, the Tourmaline Oil plans to use the net proceeds to repurchase its shares under its NCIB. The company said it continues to view Topaz Energy as a high-quality business, but currently sees greater value in its shares.
Separately, the company raised its quarterly base dividend by 5% to C$0.525 per share, or C$2.10 annualized, starting in Q4 2026.
The Q4 dividend is expected to be declared in early December and paid on December 31, 2026, to shareholders of record on December 15 as per the official report.

title: Tourmaline Oil to sell $287.5M Topaz stake to fund share buybacks
